title: New Orleans vs Mexico City: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Mexico City for value, cultural depth, and scale — but New Orleans is unrepeatable American soul.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: New Orleans wins for unique Creole/Cajun soul; Mexico City wins for volume, variety, and world-class fine dining at budget prices.

categories.name: Cultural Attractions
categories.summary: Teotihuacán, Anthropology Museum, Frida Kahlo, Diego Rivera murals — CDMX is a cultural powerhouse.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: CDMX is 3x cheaper: budget -55/day vs NOLA's -130/day.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: NOLA wins for walkable, 24/7, open-container jazz bar culture on Frenchmen Street.

categories.name: Safety
categories.summary: Both are safe in tourist zones. CDMX's Roma/Condesa often safer than NOLA's French Quarter after midnight.

categories.name: Transit
categories.summary: CDMX Metro covers the city for /bin/zsh.30/ride. NOLA is largely car-dependent outside the streetcar routes.

categories.name: Weather
categories.summary: CDMX mild year-round at 7,350ft elevation. NOLA brutal in summer (hurricane season + heat).

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Teotihuacán, Puebla, Xochimilco, Taxco vs. swamp tours and Plantation Road.

faq.question: Is New Orleans or Mexico City better for food?
faq.answer: Both are food pilgrimages. New Orleans wins for unique Creole/Cajun cuisine; Mexico City wins for variety and value.

faq.question: Is Mexico City safe for tourists in 2026?
faq.answer: Yes — Roma Norte, Condesa, and Polanco are safe tourist zones. Use Uber, not street taxis.

faq.question: How expensive is New Orleans vs Mexico City?
faq.answer: Mexico City is 3x cheaper. Budget -55/day in CDMX vs -130/day in New Orleans.
